newsitem.title: UK: Deferred soymeal sharply lower on UK meals market.
newsitem.headline: Deferred soymeal sharply lower on UK meals market.

text.p: Deferred soymeal positions were sharply lower on the UK meals and feeds market on Friday following the lower close in Chicago.
Offers for nearby material were hard to come by with the mills and most stores not offering before first half December.
Traders said mills in the UK and Europe could not run at full capacity owing to delays in shipments of beans from origin.
Traders added that the Seaforth mill was said to have sold all its meal for November.
"You are not going to find any cheap soymeal during November and possible December," said a trader.
Spot high protein soymeal traded ex-store Humberside at 202 stg and 203 stg a tonne while in Teignmouth 202 stg was paid ex-store.
Spot rapemeal on the resale market fetched 126 stg a tonne.
Soymeal sellers were down four to five stg a tonne from first half December onwards.
First half December high protein soymeal ex-mill was offered at 194 stg with second half at 192 stg.
Stores were offering the same positions at 193.50 stg and 191.50 stg a tonne.
